hook: Sony Music owes a producer $1.25 million and might never pay.

sections.voiceover: Sony Music owes a producer $1.25 million and might never pay.
In 2026, producer Ishmael Sadiq Montague sued Sony Music in federal court. Will $1.25 million royalty claim ever be honored?
The filing also accuses Sony of fraudulent and negligent misrepresentation.

Montague demands $1.2475 million, saying Sony paid only half his agreed share. The lawsuit claims Sony’s payment violated the $1.5 million contract. A ruling for Montague would force Sony to cover the missing $1.2475 million.
Sony still owes the $1.25 million claim in full.
